info.title: Lastmod API
info.description: The read-only API of Lastmod (`/v1`). A field may be added; renaming, removing or changing the type of a field only happens in a new version. Timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC, days are `YYYY-MM-DD`.

get.description: The websites within the scope of the key.

400.description: An invalid or unknown query parameter.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired key. The response carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`.

404.description: The website or object does not exist, or falls outside the scope of the key (deliberately the same response).

429.description: Too many requests. `Retry-After` says after how many seconds you can retry.

get.description: The opportunities of a website, with a filter on status and type.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The language of the texts (`reason`, `recommendedAction`, task titles). Defaults to `en`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only opportunities with this status. Without this parameter `RESOLVED` and `VOIDED` are omitted; `ALL` returns every status in one list.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only opportunities of this `type`, as it appears in the list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of opportunities per page, at most 200 (also the default). `meta.truncated` is `true` if there are more; then follow `meta.nextCursor`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `meta.nextCursor` of the previous page. Sorted by `lastSeenAt` descending, then `id`.

apiKey.description: An API key `lm_…` from your organisation settings, sent as `Authorization: Bearer lm_…`.

truncated.description: `true` = the list was cut off at the server cap; there are more rows than shown here.

clientLabel.description: An internal label for the client (for an agency: the client name); `null` = not set.

client.description: The agency client this website belongs to; `null` = no client. `clientLabel` is the name of this client and stays; `id` is stable and groups websites of the same client (renaming does not change it).

contentLanguage.description: The content language of the website (primary subtag, e.g. `nl`); `null` = not determined yet.

searchConsole.description: Only the status of the Search Console connection; `null` = never connected.

V1ProofKind.description: What an opportunity promises to prove: `implementation` = the change can be checked on the page, `clicks` = a before/after click comparison, `publication` = a count after publication (no effect claim), `decision` = a decision by the customer. An added value is not a breaking change: expect unknown values.

pageUrl.description: The page the opportunity is about; `null` for a site-wide opportunity.

effort.description: How much work: `LOW` (a text change) or `MEDIUM`; `null` = no estimate stored.

confidence.description: "Certainty of the advice": higher = more certain. An assessment of the advice, not a measurement.

proof.description: The proof family of this opportunity type; `null` = a type we do not know.

data.description: The recorded evidence; its shape depends on `source`.

pageUrl.description: The page the opportunity is about; `null` for a site-wide opportunity.

effort.description: How much work: `LOW` (a text change) or `MEDIUM`; `null` = no estimate stored.

confidence.description: "Certainty of the advice": higher = more certain. An assessment of the advice, not a measurement.

proof.description: The proof family of this opportunity type; `null` = a type we do not know.

resolution.description: How the opportunity was resolved, if it was (the latest resolution, also after reopening).

taskId.description: The id of the task that came out of this opportunity (status `CONVERTED`).

V1DetailMeta.description: The `meta` of a single opportunity: the language of the texts.

truncated.description: `true` = the list was cut off at the server cap; there are more rows than shown here.

resolvedCount.description: Number of resolved opportunities within the type filter, for an "N resolved" line.

lastScanAt.description: Start of the latest successful scan; `null` = never scanned.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` for the next page; `null` = last page.

truncated.description: `true` = the list was cut off at the server cap; there are more rows than shown here.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` for the next page; `null` = last page.

createdAt.description: Creation time and latest status change; `null` = unknown.

measurement.description: Only the state of the measurement; the figures are in the results. `null` = not measured yet.

voided.description: The system declared the detection behind this task incorrect; `null` = not voided.

stepProgress.description: Progress of the steps of a site-wide task; `null` = no steps.

proof.description: The proof family of the opportunity behind this task; `null` = unknown. Determines what `measurement` means.

deltaPct.description: Fraction (0.18 = +18%); `null` if the change is not defined (baseline zero). What it is measured against is stated in `comparison`.

confidenceBand.description: "Reliability of the measurement". A measurement alongside other changes, not a proven cause.

confounded.description: `true` = something else was going on too (see `confoundReasons`): a mixed picture.

outcome.description: The outcome in one word: `confounded` = a mixed picture, `insufficient` = too little to say, `stable` = no noticeable difference, `positive` or `declined` = the direction of `deltaPct`. A measurement alongside other changes, not a proven cause.

comparison.description: What `deltaPct` is measured against: `control` = a comparison group of pages without a task; `beforeAfter` = the period before; `null` = a result from before comparison groups existed (also the period before).

V1ResultComparison.description: The comparison group of a result. `stratum` names the kind of group. `pageDeltaPct` is the change of the page itself, `controlDeltaPct` that of the group.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` for the next page; `null` = last page.

upcoming.description: Only on the first page (without cursor): measurements still running.

previousCovered.description: `false` = the stored data does not fully cover the previous period: `previous` is then a sum over fewer days and not worth comparing. Also applies to `searchPresence`.

date.description: A day (`YYYY-MM-DD`), for `week` the Monday of the ISO week.

clicks.description: For `week` the average per known day (the sum is in `totals`).

lowVolume.description: Low traffic: the value is mostly noise.

settled.description: `false` = still provisional; Search Console corrects recent days.

endDate.description: Only for `event`: end of a rollout.

gaps.description: Days within the period without a measurement.

sourceMayHaveChanged.description: `true` = the source (Search Console property) may have changed within the period.

sourceChangeDates.description: The days on which the source changed; the properties themselves are not included.

V1VisibilitySourceType.description: The kind of website of a source in an AI answer.

requiredObservations.description: This many successful observations are needed before a figure appears.

V1VisibilityResultInsufficientData.description: Not enough observations yet: no figure, but the counts.

mentioned.description: In how many answers the website or brand was mentioned.

cited.description: In how many answers a page of the website was cited as a source.

answersWithSources.description: Answers with recorded sources; answers without sources are not counted.

V1VisibilitySources.description: The sources of successful answers per source type: in how many answers at least one source of that type appeared.

answers.description: Successful answers of that engine in the window.

questions.description: Distinct questions with a successful answer from that engine.

V1VisibilityReliability.description: How reliable the figures are, with the counts behind the band.

V1VisibilityStop.description: Why nothing is measured right now (for all questions).

V1VisibilityOutlook.description: Per engine whether a figure is within reach: an estimate based on the schedule, not a prediction of the outcome.

containsBrand.description: The question names the brand or the domain.

unavailableEngines.description: Engines with earlier observations in the window that are not measured now: "not measured", never a percentage.

retrievedNotCited.description: Answers in which the engine looked at one of your pages but did not cite it; `null` = unknown.

absentPrompts.description: Questions in which the website does not (yet) appear; `promptIds` refers to `prompts[].id`.

brandPrompts.description: Questions with the brand or the domain, as a count only.

googleAiOverview.description: A Google result with or without an AI Overview, per search term.

lastObservedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the latest successful observation; `null` = never.

nextMeasurementOn.description: UTC day on which the next measurement is scheduled; `null` = unknown or stopped.

windowEnd.description: Exclusive; equal to `windowStart` of the current measurement.

previous.description: The same proportion per engine over the window before: a separate observation of its own, without a difference or direction. `null` = no tracked questions.

V1Visibility.description: The AI visibility of a website over a recent window, per engine.

V1VisibilityRounds.description: The completed measurement rounds, oldest first, side by side without a difference or trend.

status.description: A suggested question awaits approval in the customer app; only a tracked (`ACTIVE`) question is measured.

theme.description: The topic of the question; `null` while not yet classified.

limit.description: The number of tracked questions the plan allows.

V1VisibilityPrompts.description: The tracked and suggested questions. Read-only: you manage questions in the customer app.

type.description: The kind of website of a source in an AI answer.

otherHosts.description: Hosts that are not named, as a count. Your own site is not counted.

V1VisibilityThemeSources.description: A source by name: only recurring hosts of a known source type.

answers.description: Successful answers of this engine to the questions of the topic, in the window.

flagged.description: Flagged as a topic to work on.

answersSinceTask.description: Successful answers since the task; `null` without a task. A count, not a comparison.

sources.description: `null` when there is too little to name sources.

publishedUrl.description: The page that carries the content; `null` until the task is done.

opportunity.description: The opportunity and the task that followed from the scan; `id` refers to `/v1/websites/{id}/opportunities/{id}`.

observationsTruncated.description: The read limit was reached: the oldest answers are missing from the counts.

V1VisibilityThemes.description: "Where you are missing": topics with answer counts per engine. An observation, not a judgement.

state.description: `NOT_MEASURED_YET`: the source started after the covered days; `sessions` is then `null` (unknown).

measuredFrom.description: From this day (YYYY-MM-DD) Lastmod measures this source for this website.

sessions.description: `null` with `MEASURED` = too few observations to show, never 0.
`null` = too few to show, or `status` is not `OK`.

includesSourcesBelowThreshold.description: The total includes sessions of sources too small to show: it is then a lower bound.

status.description: `NOT_CONNECTED` = no Google Analytics connected; `NOT_MEASURED` = no covered day yet.

previous.description: The same count over the equally long period before, without a difference; `null` = that period was not covered.

V1AiReferrals.description: Sessions in Google Analytics that come from AI assistants, as context for the website. Only covered days count.

V1Error.description: An error. `message` is a text, or for a validation error (400) a list of texts. Some errors carry an `errorCode`.
